run_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_train: run the EQACNNPretrainTrainer train method to pre-train the MultitaskCNN encoder-decoder model for EQA feature extraction
run_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_eval_checkpoin: run the EQACNNPretrainTrainer _eval_checkpoint method to evaluate a saved checkpoint on the validation dataset
create_EQACNNPretrainTrainer: create an EQACNNPretrainTrainer instance with a config to set up the device and logging for EQA pre-training
review_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_save_result: review the EQACNNPretrainTrainer _save_results method that saves RGB, segmentation, and depth reconstruction results
review_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_make_result: review the EQACNNPretrainTrainer _make_results_dir method that creates output directories for RGB, segmentation, and depth results
